Burned per month

IMD burned in each calendar month, split the same way. The current month is partial.

BurnExecutor amounts are dated by their Ethereum bridge transaction; the burn on Base can land up to a day later, so the native line dips by up to ~1,700 IMD on two days. Base is sampled at midnight UTC each day; Ethereum and Robinhood are summed from every transfer into their burn wallets.

Base burns: native vs. BurnExecutor

The BurnExecutor on Ethereum collects IMD, bridges it to a burn receiver on Base (0xf9d7…6793) and the receiver burns everything it holds. Everything else burned on Base counts as native.

Burnkeepers

Wallets that sign the Ethereum transactions sending the BurnExecutor's IMD to Base, where it is burned. On the current executor anyone can do this; the caller pays the LayerZero fee and gas.

Where the BurnExecutor's IMD comes from

Every IMD transfer into the two BurnExecutors on Ethereum, grouped by where it came from. Moves between the two executors are left out.

Community coins: the LaunchpadHook's burn fee on every community-coin trade, sent in batches. IMD/ETH pool: the CappedBurnHook on the main IMD/ETH Uniswap v4 pool, plus a few other v4 routes. Swarm launches: contracts launched through imd.fun that pass IMD to the executor. Named wallets send IMD by hand.

Launched tokens with built-in burns

Community coins (communitycoins.imd.fun) pay a burn fee in IMD on every trade. Swarm launches (imd.fun Launch, Ethereum) are listed when they have burn contracts or have sent IMD to the BurnExecutor. Ordered by IMD sent to burn.

Refresh this page

Anyone can order the next refresh for 0.5 IMD. The contract pays the IMD swarm to rebuild this page from the chains; the new version replaces this one about twenty minutes later.

Contract 0x6585…7009 on Ethereum · needs a browser wallet on Ethereum mainnet · the page reads public RPCs and an IPFS gateway, nothing else.

Burn what the executor holds

IMD from pool fees and launches collects on the Ethereum BurnExecutor. Anyone can send what it holds to Base, where it is burned on arrival. You pay the LayerZero fee in ETH and the gas; the IMD is not yours and never passes through your wallet.

BurnExecutor 0xe293…c750 · LaunchpadHook 0x5176…2888 · Ethereum mainnet · the page reads public RPCs, nothing else.

Ordinary bridging (IMD locked on Base and minted on Ethereum or Robinhood, or burned there and released on Base) is not counted: it moves IMD, it doesn't remove it.

BurnExecutor on Etherscan: Write Contract ↗ · Anyone can send the IMD the BurnExecutor holds to Base, where it is burned (bridgeToBaseBurnReceiver); the caller pays the LayerZero fee and gas.
